Definition: Tubal, a postdiluvian patriarch and his posterity
BiblicalUsage: Tubal = "thou shall be brought"; n pr m; 1) son of Japheth and grandson of Noah; n pr terr; 2) a region in east Asia Minor; 2a) perhaps nearly equal to Cappadocia
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
